title: A botanical family
description: The family a crop belongs to, which rotation and the family rules join on (PRD 11, FR-GA18 C2, C3 and C6, FR-GA21). One file per family, garden/families/<key>.json.

key.description: The family's key, its Latin name in lower case, and the file's name: the record's key, the one field without a source.

name.description: The family's everyday name in each language, as a gardener says it.

name_latin.description: The family's botanical name, the same in every language.
